task: Design and implement the Starlight Agentic Graph Atlas as an operator-grade interactive architecture surface.
surface: Responsive Next.js graph atlas and target-architecture page
audience: Frank, Starlight operators, creators, developers, and prospective platform users
first_read: Starlight is one governed operating graph with many domain projections, not a directory of disconnected agents.

references.label: SIS Civic Intelligence territory
references.reason: Warm institutional light, near-black ink, documentary proof, and restrained intervention color

references.label: Graph atlas model
references.reason: Exact machine-readable source for every rendered node, edge, route, law, benchmark, and roadmap item

references.label: Estate census
references.reason: Reproducible evidence for the opening ledger

keep: Editorial hierarchy with a legible first read
Evidence and provenance visible in the interface
Keyboard-accessible node inspection and route filtering
direction.signature: A civic intelligence drafting table where every graph edge exposes the contract it carries.
system: Newsreader display serif with Inter body and JetBrains Mono provenance labels
Warm paper, navy ink, oxidized red selection, and safety yellow focus
Fine documentary rules instead of floating cards
Content-sized diagram bounds with fit/enlarge controls, keyboard tabs and a native node selector
Motion limited to brief state transitions and disabled under reduced motion
